title.zh: 将邦阿西楠省巴亚姆邦市镇帕拉戈斯社区学校的名称变更为帕拉戈斯-圣加布里埃尔第二社区学校的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Paragos Community School in the Municipality of Bayambang, Province of Pangasinan, to Paragos-San Gabriel II Community School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Paragos Community School in the Municipality of Bayambang, Province of Pangasinan, to Paragos-San Gabriel II Community School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Paragos Community School tại Thị trấn Bayambang, Tỉnh Pangasinan thành Paragos-San Gabriel II Community School
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อ Paragos Community School ในเทศบาล Bayambang, จังหวัด Pangasinan เป็น Paragos-San Gabriel II Community School
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Paragos Community School di Kotamadya Bayambang, Provinsi Pangasinan menjadi Paragos-San Gabriel II Community School
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Paragos Community School di Perbandaran Bayambang, Wilayah Pangasinan menjadi Paragos-San Gabriel II Community School

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1960/ra_2841_1960.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of Paragos Community School in the Municipality of Bayambang, Province of Pangasinan, is hereby changed to Paragos-San Gabriel II Community School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 19, 1960.
